figures.caption: Agent received higher overall ratings, mainly in evidence support and requirement completion.
LLM scored slightly higher on factual accuracy. Agent and LLM tied on boundary handling.
Agent exceeded LLM on all nine tasks and tied Workflow on Q4 and Q9.
The largest mean gap from Workflow occurred in reliability tasks: 7.75 versus 4.50 points.
All 108 dimension ratings are shown. Q9 Workflow and Agent entries are both 2/2/2/2.
Q6 and Q7 contribute 11 of the 19 cumulative Agent-Workflow rating points.
